answer: Every identity must be sponsored by an established agent that locks a slashable collateral bond and signs a provenance record, like a vine allowed to climb only one trellis. If the sponsored identity is later proven Sybil by peer juries, the bond is burned and the sponsor's standing takes a hit; each sponsor may hold only a handful of active bonds per epoch. Forging a fake army is like writing a sonnet - each fake costs a real bond and a real sponsor relationship, and the sponsor is the bridge carrying risk back to real capital, so Sybil scale burns attacker money before it buys any influence.
